evals.prompt: Avisame por Telegram cuando termine este backtest largo
evals.expected_output: Mensaje de estado al completar, con reintentos si falla el envio
expectations: Sends a status message when the run completes
Retries on send failure and never blocks the main task
Reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID from the environment, never hardcoded

evals.prompt: Enviame este PDF del reporte por Telegram
expectations: Uploads the file as a document to the configured chat
Checks that the file exists before sending
Reports the API result or logs a warning on failure

evals.prompt: Manda alerta a Telegram si el drawdown supera el 10% en el monitoreo
evals.expected_output: Alerta condicional con formato MarkdownV2/HTML valido
expectations: Escapes MarkdownV2 or HTML so the API does not reject the message
Does not send when the condition is false
